name: ExpandableTile

props.name: decorator
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `decorator` component to be rendered inside the `ExpandableTile` component

props.name: hasRoundedCorners
props.description: **Experimental**: Specify if the `ExpandableTile` component should be rendered with rounded corners. Only valid when `slug` prop is present

props.name: slug
props.description: Specify the function to run when the ExpandableTile is clicked / onClick?(event: MouseEvent): void; /** optional handler to trigger a function when a key is pressed / onKeyUp?(event: KeyboardEvent): void; /** **Experimental**: Provide a `Slug` component to be rendered inside the `ExpandableTile` component

props.name: tileCollapsedIconText
props.description: The description of the "collapsed" icon that can be read by screen readers.

props.name: tileCollapsedLabel
props.description: When "collapsed", a label to appear next to the chevron (e.g., "View more").

props.name: tileExpandedIconText
props.description: The description of the "expanded" icon that can be read by screen readers.

props.name: tileExpandedLabel
props.description: When "expanded", a label to appear next to the chevron (e.g., "View less").

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon ExpandableTile rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
